It's nothing. Even my horoscope says that today is an unlucky day.
Do you actually believe in that nonsense?
Now I always have a lucky day!
Chef, we turned everything upside down — there is no elephant.
Search, Senya, search!
Find me the elephant!
Max, you and I still haven't talked.
Yes, Vika, forgive me, I got swamped.
Vika, let's do it later, okay? Otherwise Nagiyev gets impatient.
It looks cool.
And it tastes even better!

examples.trans: It is delicious, after all! Try it.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'else/more', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Ещё в каком! Это же моя золотая вещь для сигар.
examples.trans: Better than ever! This is my gold cutter for cigars.

examples.text: Я тебя ещё догоню. Я помоложе буду.
examples.trans: I will catch up to you yet. I am younger.

examples.text: Приготовь мне ещё что-нибудь необычное!
examples.trans: Prepare something else unusual for me!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'better', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Дима, а можешь по такому радостному случаю поднять зарплату?
examples.trans: Dima, on such a joyful occasion can you raise my salary?

examples.text: На вкус ещё лучше!
examples.trans: And it tastes even better!

examples.text: Так лучше.
examples.trans: It's better like this.
